content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MACT Baghpat Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MACT Baghpat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for MACT Baghpat Recruitment 2026 is 24th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for MACT Baghpat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the recruitment of Assistant Accountant, Computer Assistant, and Computer Programmer posts in the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Baghpat.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Computer Assistant and Computer Programmer posts?
faq.answer: For both Computer Assistant and Computer Programmer positions, candidates must possess a Graduate degree along with a Computer Science diploma/degree or an O-Level certificate or a CCC certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to MACT Baghpat posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all the posts is between 21 years to 40 years. No age relaxation details are provided in the extracted data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for all the posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MACT Baghpat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for MACT Baghpat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for MACT Baghpat Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for MACT Baghpat Recruitment 2026 involves two main stages: Application Screening and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is on a contract basis. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contractual term.

faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Baghpat. Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
